title: Directed continuity for the canonical etale section cocone
statement: Let I be a nonempty directed preorder and R a scheme [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. Let B : I opposite -> R.Etale be a diagram of etale schemes [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], with qcqs stages and affine transitions. Let c be a limit cone of its underlying scheme diagram, and let p : c.pt -> R satisfy c_i followed by the structure map of B_i = p. For a sheaf H of sets [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaf-of-sets], let nu be a natural transformation from B opposite followed by H to the constant diagram with value (p inverse image H)(c.pt). Suppose each nu_i is the inverse-image adjunction unit [lem-weil-pbc-sets-etale-inverse-image-composition-units] followed by restriction along the pullback map with components c_i and the identity [def-pc-fibre-product]. Then the cocone determined by nu is a colimit. This is only the directed continuity and identification step, not the reindexing from a general cofiltered category.

source.place: Tags 09YQ (degree-zero continuity route for sets via 0EYL, 04HR and 09YN) and 03S2; as used in Tag 03Q9

proof.text: Choose a stage i0 and restrict to its upper tail. Directedness gives nonemptiness and connectedness of each comma category of the tail inclusion, so it is cofinal and its opposite is initial. These preserve the section colimit and the scheme limit.

Pull back H to stage i0 and apply set-valued etale section continuity to its terminal etale object. The identity structure morphism is qcqs and the stage assumptions supply all other hypotheses. The bijective colimit comparison gives a colimit cocone.

Use composition of inverse images and the cone equations to identify stage and limit inverse images with those of H along their maps to R. Etale restriction at each terminal object identifies stage sections with H(B_i). The unit equations identify both transitions and limit components; the latter are the unit for p restricted along the pullback map with projections c_i and the identity. The stipulated component equations identify this cocone with Cocone.mk nu.
Transport the colimit along these natural identifications and back from the cofinal upper tail.

proof_origin.place: Tags 09YQ and 03S2, degree-zero route for sets as in the imported continuity lemma
